summary.text: Jack Bergman is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Michigan's 1st District, first elected in 2016. He retired from the U.S. Marine Corps as a lieutenant general after a 40-year military career, worked as a commercial airline pilot and small-business owner, and sits on the House Armed Services, Veterans' Affairs and Budget committees. He is seeking re-election after winning the August 4, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Bergman was born in Shakopee, Minnesota, in 1947. His official biography says he grew up in the Midwest and that his family's Michigan roots go back to ancestors who worked as iron miners in the Upper Peninsula in the late 1800s.
He earned a bachelor's degree in business from Gustavus Adolphus College in 1969 and an MBA from the University of Western Florida.
Bergman served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1969 to 2009, retiring as a lieutenant general; his official biography describes 40 years in uniform.

He worked as a commercial airline pilot for 22 years. According to his official biography, he also launched two startup businesses in the medical equipment field while in the military and owned and operated a small business.

Bergman and his wife, Cindy, settled in Watersmeet, on the western edge of the Upper Peninsula, nearly three decades ago, according to his official biography, which also says he has ten grandchildren.

He was elected to the U.S. House in 2016 and took office in 2017, representing a district that covers the Upper Peninsula and the northern Lower Peninsula. His official biography describes him as the highest-ranking combat veteran ever to serve in the House.

For 2025-2026 he holds seats on the House Armed Services Committee, where he chairs the Readiness subcommittee, and on the Veterans' Affairs and Budget committees. Earlier terms included service on Natural Resources (2017-2018) and chairing the Armed Services Intelligence and Special Operations subcommittee (2023-2024).
In the August 4, 2026 Republican primary he received 74.7% of the vote, ahead of Matthew DenOtter and Justin Michal.
